candidate.title: Change the Extension Language
candidate.practicalProblem: Helps people switch the extension interface language, confirm the change and return to English without mistaking the setting for a change to their Nostr account, keys, permissions or message content.

guide.directReaderVerification: The public English guide loaded with its title, four-step instructions, language selector, screenshots, limitations and embedded related video. The route returned the guide rather than a generic edge error page.

publicVideo.title: How to Change the Language in Nostr WoT
publicVideo.visibleDescriptionSummary: The public video description links to the matching change-language guide.

ownWorkReview.extension: GitHub release v0.8.22 is public with downloadable Chrome and Firefox build assets dated 2026-11-02. Store approval was not independently verified, so the release was not selected or described as newly available in stores.
ownWorkReview.sdk: The latest GitHub SDK release remains nostr-wot-sdk 3.0.1 with @nostr-wot/identity 1.1.0 from 2026-10-23. It was already covered and has durable LinkedIn and Nostr receipts.
guideMediaBacklog: Managing identity and removing accounts already have seeded social entries but no durable receipts; both reservations remain pending and were not retried.
Change language, zapping auto-approve and authentication tutorials have registered public media without matching social files.
Change language was selected because its live guide and exact public video were directly verified and it solves a distinct interface-recovery problem.

deduplication.latestConfirmedReceipt: amethyst-1-21-napplets-and-web-of-trust has a durable Nostr receipt dated 2026-11-03

supported: The guide uses four steps to change the extension language.

Some appearance labels may remain in English.
notMade: The language feature is newly released.
